user_decision: Accounts authorized to create outbound drafts must be able to receive their PX on explicit SAVE; no IAM grant changes
canonical_authority: ACTIVE account with an effective server-side SUPER_ADMIN role_code assignment, as already recognized by the P03 owner. Role display_name, arbitrary ADMIN roles, expired/inactive assignments and client claims do not qualify.

ordinary_roles.save_record: ACTIVE outbound.scan AND (outbound.request.manual_create OR outbound.import) with role scope matching the confirmed warehouse or genuine global grant; direct active grants unchanged

unchanged_guards: stock availability and RECORD field matrix
number_allocation: Only successful explicit authorized SAVE; no allocation on GET, old receipt replay or unknown-result reconciliation
context: P05 permissions read/save/cancel/record intersect the existing P03 rights with the same current-warehouse authorization used by the numbered owner; a grant belonging only to another warehouse never advertises current-warehouse creation.
app: Existing r1 wire parser remains compatible. Honor data.permissions.save plus numbering.allowed and schema_ready; screen visibility alone is never create permission. Do not override numbering.allowed=false by falling back to a more general permission flag. Do not manufacture PX or create a replacement draft/key after UNKNOWN. Preserve source-linked document number.
release: Source/test evidence is not live authenticated SAVE or App UAT PASS. DEV/TEST only; production unchanged.
